title: Delete Google Calendar events with AI, one date at a time
h1: remove the right google calendar event
description: Clear the Google Calendar event you meant to cancel. Choose the date, keep the rest of a repeating series and decide who gets a cancellation notice.
keyword: google calendar delete event with ai
answer: **free the slot without wiping the whole series.** a bot can delete a google calendar event, including one occurrence of a repeating meeting. name the calendar and date so it finds the right one. deletion counts as a calendar change, so put the confirmation step in your request rather than relying on sending approval.

review.by: lead agent, after two independent reviewer passes, against Metal docs and the composio catalog

og_line: free the slot. keep the rest of the series.
what:
**cancel friday's meeting and keep next week's.** give the bot an event reference or ask it to find the meeting. name the date you mean; deleting the series removes every occurrence.

google can email guests about the cancellation. choose who should hear, since those notices don't follow dusk's sending setting. your connected account needs permission to delete from that calendar.
uses: cancel a training session after the facilitator withdraws it
remove one date during an office closure while keeping the series
clear an abandoned personal planning block from the right calendar

routine.message: every monday at 4, find next week’s work-calendar events whose titles start with "temporary hold:". ask me before you change anything. show the title, date and whether each event repeats. ask which exact events to delete and who should get cancellation notices. delete only the events i confirm, then report the result here. never delete a whole series. never call a failed lookup a cancellation.
routine.needs: google calendar read and write; permission to delete the chosen events
routine.output:
temporary hold: wrenstone visit
friday 10:00: one standalone event.
waiting for your deletion and notification choices.

steps: connect the calendar; allow **read and write** only when you need cancellations
ask the bot to show the title, calendar, date and whether it repeats
write the ask-first rule in the routine; sending approval does not hold this change
open your calendar and confirm that only the chosen event disappeared
watch: **find the event before calling it cancelled.** a failed lookup can mean you searched the wrong calendar.
**use an account with deletion rights.** subscribed calendars can refuse changes even when you can read them.
**one date and the whole series are different jobs.** name the exact occurrence.

faq.q: will dusk ask before cancelling a meeting?
faq.a: **only if you tell it to.** the sending control does not hold this calendar change. write the confirmation step into your request.

faq.q: can it delete only next week's occurrence?
faq.a: **yes, choose the dated occurrence.** have it show that date before deleting, and leave the series alone.

steps: find one event without changing it
read its date, calendar and series
choose who gets a cancellation notice

mistakes.mistake: trusting the sending setting to hold deletions
mistakes.fix: include a confirmation step in the routine itself.
name the date and say whether you mean one occurrence or the series.

tip.text: say "only this occurrence" when you mean one meeting in a repeating series.
